# wip skill v0.4.0 changelog

- Expanded Don't/Do table to prevent common mode-misapplication errors.

- Added environment-agnostic "resume" workflow for task cleanup and remaining-work handling (resume.md).

- Updated triggers and quick reference: now supports "compact recovery", "task resume", "cleanup + resume".
